BiblicalUsage: The fisherman appears twice, casting his net in the waters and angling on the shore. Isaiah pictures the fishers mourning when the waters fail, and Jeremiah sends for many fishers who will fish the people out of every hole and hiding place. The net gathers what the hook cannot reach.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the fishers are the picture of God's own work: He sends for His people where they hide, and He draws them in.
